relationships.name: Transaction
relationships.description: A money transfer from one account to another.

relationships.name: Ownership
relationships.description: An owner is linked to the account(s) they own.

elements.description: owner_id of the owners of destination accounts

assumptions: Each account has a unique account_number.
Each owner has a unique owner_id.
An account is owned by exactly one owner (or the query will return all owners if many-to-many).
The Transaction table records both source_account_number and destination_account_number.
uncertainties: If an account has multiple owners, the query may return duplicate owner_ids.
Transactions may be missing or incomplete for account 108.
Owner IDs may not be numeric; the test assumes integer IDs.

decisions.initial_cypher:
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:TRANSFER]->(dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})<-[:OWN]-(owner {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN DISTINCT owner.id AS owner_id
ORDER BY owner_id ASC
LIMIT $limit
